new_tests.test_unrelated_plugin_blocks_are_preserv: Nonconflicting custom layer block and plugin list retained in both costmaps; source bytes unchanged.

initial_baseline_note: First draft used a shared output directory across subtests: the first case reproduced missing rejection, but its output caused later subtests to see file-exists errors. Fixed test isolation with a separate directory per case before running the corrected config module. Then ran the isolated new case against the saved original module, verifying __file__ points at that backup; all four cases independently reproduced missing rejection.
